text: Tree-cover loss on the property has shown a slight increase in recent years, though the overall trend is modest. The largest loss event occurred in 2021, with 81.3 hectares affected (2.23% of the asset). In 2022, loss dropped significantly to just 0.6 hectares (0.02%), but it rose again in 2023 to 4.5 hectares (0.12%). Historically, annual losses were small and relatively stable, averaging around 1.5 hectares per year before 2020. While 2021 was an outlier, the 2023 loss suggests a minor upward trend compared to earlier years. Overall, recent losses remain low relative to the asset’s size, but monitoring is warranted for any further increases.
